text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  link-checker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run lychee link checker
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v1.9.0
        with:
          args: --verbose --accept=200,201,202,403,429 --exclude-loopback .
```
